info.title: cancho-hooks
info.description: Events are on disk before the answer to `POST /events`, then signed (Standard Webhooks), retried and replayable. Delivery is at least once: a receiver drops a repeat by `webhook-id` (`evt_<id>`). Every route, its scope and its answers are also described in docs/api.md. This document is generated from the declaration the service routes with (src/api.cho).

200.description: Always 200 while the loop turns, even with the disk full.
